scientific_interpretation: The frozen equal-three-seed EMA-JEPA ensemble reduced the retrospective TEST primary raw pinball loss by 5.2243 percent relative to the frozen direct ensemble, its fixed paired interval excludes zero in the favorable direction, and every horizon stayed below the regression guard. It therefore passes the complete frozen within-study retrospective gate.

This is positive performance evidence for the selected EMA-JEPA forecast family on this one retrospective AEON deployment and time split. It is not a sealed-holdout, SOTA, external-generalization or universal JEPA claim.

The validation comparison had not established an EMA advantage, the family-selection rule was frozen post hoc after development outcomes, and TRAIN diagnostics showed low effective rank while a frozen-random hybrid beat learned hybrids in development. Those facts continue to limit attribution of the TEST gain specifically to learned JEPA representations.

The exploratory post-hoc LightGBM arm improved on direct by 3.7602 percent and its paired interval excludes zero, but it fails the fixed five-percent point requirement and therefore fails the incremental and full promotion rules.

CAL widening raised retrospective TEST interval coverage above 90 percent for all models and horizons. Raw five-quantile pinball remains the primary score; widened intervals are calibration diagnostics rather than a new selection criterion.
limitations: The source clock timezone and product availability latency remain unspecified; source dates are source-reported rather than UTC.

This single fixed lander and conditioned hourly FullDepth product do not establish calibrated absolute backscatter, species, biomass, catch, causality, operational savings, production readiness or business value.
Publisher preprocessing, filtering and manual exclusions are not independently reprocessed from raw echograms.
The result must be integrated with its retrospective, post-hoc-selection and representation-diagnostic caveats; the historical v1 failed eligibility findings and blocked registry remain unchanged.
